compos.summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a web page from "Popular Science" with a URL at the top. The main content of the web page is obscured by a pop-up message. The pop-up message, from "http://com-344.com," addresses the user as "Loyale User" and informs them that they have been selected to receive three free spins in an iPhone 7 contest as a token of appreciation. The message ends with a wish for good luck. The pop-up provides two options for the user: "Cancel" and "OK."
